records.name: Commander Shepard
records.sourceWork: Mass Effect 2 (2010), default male Soldier Shepard
records.identity: Commander Shepard, default adult MALE fictional video-game appearance from Mass Effect2(2010), close-cropped dark hair and short stubble, black/charcoal N7 hard-surface armor with original red-and-white N7 stripe, no helmet. Broad athletic military build. Hold the angular black/grey M-8 AVENGER assault rifle in both hands, stock against shoulder and clear short horizontal barrel. Use the attached old sprite for identity/armor only; REMOVE its ME3 orange omni-blade. No Sentinel field, biotic hand power, Mako or vehicle.
records.superAction: CONCUSSIVE SHOT: real kinetic combat power fired from the M-8 Avenger. Four new poses: planted shoulder brace and raised rifle with clear barrel facingRIGHT; tight two-hand aim with torso forward; visible rifle recoil with ONE compact pale-blue/white concussive charge leaving the actual muzzle; finally lower rifle and recover. Finite fired round, never continuous laser, grenade volley, hand beam, blade or magic. Show the barrel aperture clearly.
records.finale: Non-graphic Concussive Shot demonstration: low brace and raise rifle, aim barrel RIGHT, one recoil with a small finite muzzle discharge, safely lower rifle. No victim or gore.
records.sourceReference: ME2 Soldier has Adrenaline Rush and Concussive Shot and can use the M-8 Avenger assault rifle. Adrenaline Rush is adapted to a short bounded personal attack buff; the global simulation clock is unchanged. Concussive Shot is the ordinary single-target combat shot, not the optional Concussive Blast area evolution. Cover is personal physical protection. No ME3 omni-blade, Adept Singularity, Sentinel Tech Armor, Mako attack or inherited caller class power.

records.name: Garrus Vakarian
records.sourceWork: Mass Effect 2 (2010), scarred Garrus after Archangel recruitment
records.identity: Garrus Vakarian, adult TURIAN alien from Mass Effect2(2010), tall lean digitigrade armored body, bony avian/reptilian turian face with side mandibles and swept cranial plates, no human ears/hair or beak-mask helmet. Pale grey-brown facial plates, dark blue markings and visible battle SCARS on right cheek/mandible after recruitment. Small BLUE tactical VISOR over LEFT eye. Original fitted blue and charcoal combat armor, damaged/scuffed. Carries a real long black/grey M-92 MANTIS sniper rifle with shoulder stock, scope and clear narrow barrel facingRIGHT. The old sprite wrongly lacks his rifle; include it. No wings, feathers, biotic aura or unscarred alternate costume.
records.superAction: CONCUSSIVE SHOT: ME2 combat ammunition power from actual rifle, not Overload or a mine. Four different poses: shoulder rifle and set digitigrade feet; settle behind scope with clear horizontal barrel aimedRIGHT; compact rifle recoil and a short pale-blue/white concussive round at its real muzzle; finally lower rifle and recover without firing. No energy from empty fingers, Killbox ring, floating rifles, grenade carpet or laser.
records.finale: Non-graphic Concussive Shot drill: low sniper ready stance, kneel into precise aim, one aimed kinetic rifle discharge, lower weapon and stand. No victim or blood.
records.sourceReference: ME2 Garrus uses assault and sniper rifles. His powers are Concussive Shot, Overload, Turian Rebel and loyalty Armor-Piercing Ammo. The selected super is the ordinary single-target Concussive Shot from his weapon, not an invented Killbox or a proximity mine. Overload is his real tech attack, adapted to one electrical impact without changing its identity to biotics. Personal cover does not grant an allied shield.

records.name: Liara T'Soni
records.sourceWork: Mass Effect 2: Lair of the Shadow Broker (2010)
records.identity: Liara T’Soni, adult ASARI game character in Mass Effect2 Lair of the Shadow Broker2010. Blue skin, smooth swept-back asari cranial crest/tentacle ridges attached to skull, mature blue face, NO human hair, elf ears or anime spikes. Original white-and-blue DLC outfit: fitted white paneled jacket with blue trim and waist belt, dark navy leggings and practical white/blue armored boots/gloves. Not a gown, ME1 green scientist suit or casual cabin dress. Compact dark M-3 PREDATOR heavy pistol holstered at hip for biotic movements and held low for idle/outro. Same outfit all rows.
records.superAction: SINGULARITY, genuine biotic power: widen stance, open blue palm with compact blue-violet energy fold near hand; turn shoulders and extend palm towardRIGHT as a small finite biotic vortex forms just ahead; maintain localized small gravitational swirl, then draw hand back and let it diminish. No data screens, hacking storm, giant laser or spellbook. Pistol holstered while casting. Four distinctly drawn full bodies, vortex never hiding body.
records.finale: Non-graphic concluding Warp demonstration: set stance, gather small blue-violet biotic fold in open palm, extend hand into one finite Warp release, relax and holster. No victim, disintegration, blood or execution.
records.sourceReference: DLC squad Liara has Singularity, Warp, Asari Scientist and Stasis, and uses heavy pistols or submachine guns. The selected M-3 Predator supplies her basic shot, Warp her secondary biotic projectile, and Singularity her localized biotic field. The field and its duration, damage and crowd control are bounded gameplay adaptations; no Shadow Broker data storm, electronic attack, ME1 Barrier loadout or instant environmental execution is asserted.
records.basicAbility: Tir du M-3 Predator de Liara

records.name: Tali Zorah
records.identity: Tali’Zorah, adult QUARIAN game character from Mass Effect2(2010), fully SEALED environmental suit. Purple hood with pale spirals, dark charcoal fitted suit/purple panels, gold/silver collar hardware, enclosed opaque purple visor with faint eye lights; NO visible bare face, exposed skin, human ears or hair. Quarian digitigrade legs, three-fingered gloved hands, practical boots. Short dark physical M-23 KATANA shotgun at low ready, slung safely when operating orange translucent forearm omni-tool. No biotic hand spell or ME3 omni-blade.
records.superAction: COMBAT DRONE selected Attack Drone technical power. Four distinct poses: shotgun slung, activate small orange forearm omni-tool; extend gloved hand as basketball-sized PURPLE/PINK spherical holographic TECH DRONE with nested rings/hexagonal light lattice appears just ahead; lean into command gesture while SAME native-drawn drone emits ONE SHORT local electric shock toRIGHT from front bright focus; finally pull hand back while drone dissipates into a few light pixels. True ME2 drone is a holographic technical sphere, NOT alien pet, robot humanoid, insect, skull, turret, flying gun or rocket. No destruction explosion or AoE blast. Every represented drone body must actually be drawn natively, wholly contained in cell.
records.finale: Non-graphic drone demonstration: activate forearm omni-tool, deploy one small purple/pink spherical holographic tech drone nearby, give one precise shock command, then recall and dismiss it. No enemy, explosion or exposed face.
records.sourceReference: Selected ME2 sealed purple enviro-suit. Combat Drone is a genuine tech projection; its Attack Drone evolution damages the target with an electrical shock. One finite shock is condensed here. Explosive Drone is a different evolution that explodes when destroyed, so the ordinary deployment is not an instantaneous group explosion. No unsealed face, alien pet, magical summon or transferred quarian biology.

records.name: Urdnot Wrex
records.sourceWork: Mass Effect (2007), heavy red-armored krogan Wrex
records.identity: Urdnot Wrex, adult KROGAN alien from original Mass Effect2007: very broad heavy torso, huge naturally humped back and thick neck, brown leathery reptilian face/red crest and old scars, short heavy muzzle/broad jaw, no human hair or helmet replacing head. Heavy original RED/charcoal krogan armor, bulky rounded shoulder/back plates, thick gauntlets, armored digitigrade legs/three-toed feet. Short heavy dark physical shotgun held low or slung. Preserve massive krogan silhouette, not a slim red human or Grunt white armor.
records.superAction: BARRIER, personal biotic protection ONLY. Four distinct poses: plant broad feet and lower/sling shotgun; brace forearms with compact BLUE/VIOLET biotic shimmer tight around own torso; turn shoulder into sturdy personal guard, barrier following ONLY Wrex; release a breath and let shimmer fade. No outward shockwave, gunfire, red blade, target impact, allied shield, heal or resurrection. Actual krogan body visible every pose.
records.finale: Non-graphic defensive conclusion: grounded brace, raise forearms into personal protection, hold unwavering BLUE/VIOLET Barrier close around own body, relax. No attack, victim, gore, healing hearts, blast or transferred protection.
records.sourceReference: Selected ME1 heavy red krogan armor. Barrier surrounds and strengthens its own user, Wrex; the project adapts the temporary personal shields to bounded self guard. It is not a group shield, heal or damage attack. Legendary Edition reference describes the original ME1 talent semantics, not original2007 frame equivalence.
